payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Betsy, Lacy, Orville, Pauletta

payload.content: Hello everyone, I am looking at the high-priority ISSUE-0002 tasks (implement, review, test) since I have strong skills in frontend and backend and these tasks fit my availability and cost constraints. Let's avoid overlaps and maximize task coverage.

To the wider group: I recommend focusing on the ISSUE-0001 tasks since they are medium priority and I will avoid the ISSUE-0002 tasks to let those who are more cost-efficient on these take them. This way, we can cover more tasks overall.
I am considering the high priority ISSUE-0002 tasks, especially review and test, given my frontend skills and availability. Planning to avoid overlaps with others and cover as many tasks as possible.

Hello all, I have strong backend skills and 8 hours available. I see Lacy and Pauletta are interested in the ISSUE-0002 high-priority tasks. I will avoid those to minimize overlap. Given my backend skill, I am considering the medium-priority ISSUE-0001 tasks, but my costs for those are quite high. I want to coordinate to avoid duplicates and cover more tasks efficiently. Thoughts on who might take which ISSUE-0001 tasks?

Following up on my previous message: Given the high cost I have for ISSUE-0001 tasks, I am open to skipping if others can cover the medium priority tasks more cost-effectively. I'll prioritize avoiding overlap with Lacy and Pauletta on ISSUE-0002 tasks. Please share your task preferences so we can optimize coverage and cost together.

Hello team, I have strong skills in security and 7 hours available. I see Lacy and Pauletta are focusing on ISSUE-0002 high-priority tasks, and Orville is open to skipping or taking ISSUE-0001 tasks. I can take on a medium-priority ISSUE-0001 task with lower cost to maximize coverage. I am considering ISSUE-0001 triage (cost 3.48) or review/docs (cost 4.35) as options. Thoughts on these choices to avoid overlaps?

Since I have a strong security skill, I believe I can efficiently handle ISSUE-0001 triage or review/docs tasks with medium priority and reasonable cost. I am open to feedback or suggestions if anyone else prefers these tasks or if there are other priorities to consider.

I suggest Betsy and Orville focus on the medium-priority ISSUE-0001 tasks to maximize overall task coverage and avoid clashes with our high-priority tasks. Let's cover as many tasks as possible efficiently.

Reminder to all: prioritize non-overlapping coverage. I will focus on ISSUE-0002 implement, Pauletta on review. Others encouraged to take ISSUE-0001 medium priority tasks to maximize sprint throughput.

Pauletta prefers to claim the high-priority ISSUE-0002 review task given her frontend skills and cost efficiency. This leaves the implement or test tasks open for others interested in ISSUE-0002 to optimize total coverage without overlap.

To all agents, Pauletta is focusing on the high-priority ISSUE-0002 review task to align with her frontend skills and availability. This leaves implement and test tasks within ISSUE-0002 to others who may be more cost-efficient or better skilled. Let's coordinate to maximize task coverage and avoid overlaps.

Hello all, based on the current discussions and my backend skills, I will skip the ISSUE-0002 high-priority tasks to avoid overlap with Lacy and Pauletta. I am open to letting Betsy take the ISSUE-0001 triage or review/docs tasks given her more cost-efficient options there. I will monitor and consider skipping if this leads to better overall coverage and cost optimization. Looking forward to your final preferences to finalize assignments.

I confirm I am targeting the ISSUE-0001 triage task given its medium priority and relatively low cost for me. I believe this complements the team's focus well and avoids overlap with high-priority ISSUE-0002 tasks others are taking. Please let me know if anyone else is interested in this task or if you prefer I switch to another medium priority task like review or docs.

I encourage Orville to consider skipping or focusing on other tasks since I am taking ISSUE-0001 triage, which I can do cost-effectively with my security skills. This will maximize task coverage and minimize cost for the team.
